mapper.select:
SELECT a.bim_tree_id FROM PROJECT_BIM_TREE_MAP a LEFT JOIN Pre_Project b ON a.project_id = b.p_id
and b.p_id = #{projectId}
and likePname(#{projectName},a.project_id)=true
and b.p_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')

select a.p_id as project_id, a.p_name as project_name, a.p_address as address, a.p_longitude as longitude, a.p_latitude as latitude from PRE_PROJECT a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_BIM_TREE_MAP b WHERE b.project_id = a.p_id)
and likePname(#{projectName},a.P_id)=true
and a.p_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
ORDER BY a.p_create_time ASC

select a.p_id from PRE_PROJECT a
and likePname(#{projectName},a.P_id)=true
and a.p_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')

select a.p_id as project_id, a.p_name as project_name from PRE_PROJECT a
and likePname(#{projectName},a.P_id)=true
and a.p_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')

select a.Con_Id as contractId, a.Con_Name as contractName from Con_Contract a
and a.Con_Name like concat('%',#{contractName},'%')

select a.p_id as project_id, a.p_name as project_name, a.p_address as address, a.p_longitude as longitude, a.p_latitude as latitude, a.p_type as projectType from PRE_PROJECT a
a.p_id in
#{item}
and likePname(#{projectName},a.P_id)=true
and a.p_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
and a.project_category_details like concat('%',#{projectCategoryDetails},'%')

select a.Con_Id from con_contract a
a.Con_Name like concat('%',#{contractName},'%')

SELECT a.*, b.plan_name FROM Gantt_Tasks a left join Gantt_Plan b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id
a.task_id in
#{item}
order by Task_Sort asc

SELECT a.* FROM Gantt_Plan a
a.plan_id in
#{item}
order by a.Plan_Create_Time desc
SELECT a.* FROM Gantt_Tasks a where a.plan_id = #{planId} order by Task_Sort asc

SELECT a.*, con.Con_Name as conName FROM Con_Boq a left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = a.Con_Id
a.boq_id in
#{item}
order by a.boq_create_time desc
select mn.* from Con_Boq_Dtl mn where mn.Boq_Id=#{boqId} order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select mn.* from Con_Boq_Dtl mn
mn.boqd_id in
#{item}
order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select count(mn.qsr_id) from Qs_Record mn where mn.qsr_state = 7 and mn.qsr_id in
#{item}

select count(mn.qsr_id) from Qs_Record mn where mn.qsr_state != 7 and mn.qsr_id in
#{item}

select con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, qt.Qst_Name as qstName, qt.Qst_Code as qstCode, qt.Qst_Item as qstItem, mn.* from Qs_Record mn left join Qs_Type qt on qt.Qst_Id=mn.Qst_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Qsr_Id where mn.Qsr_Id=#{qsrId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, qt.Qst_Name as qstName, qt.Qst_Code as qstCode, qt.Qst_Item as qstItem, mn.* from Qs_Record mn left join Qs_Type qt on qt.Qst_Id=mn.Qst_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Qsr_Id where mn.Qsr_Id in
#{item}

a.task_id in

order by Task_Sort asc

mn.boqd_id in
